description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for ADO.NET grain storage in Orleans, including classes for options, validation, and default configuration.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for ADO.NET grain storage, including connection string, init stage, invariant, serializer, and hash picker.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the correctness of AdoNetGrainStorageOptions, ensuring required fields are set.

classes.name: DefaultAdoNetGrainStorageOptionsHashPickerConfigurator
classes.description: Provides default hash picker configuration if none is set.

methods.name: UseOrleans3CompatibleHasher
methods.description: Sets a legacy hash picker compatible with Orleans v3.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the options object.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Sets default hash picker if not explicitly configured.
